item.title: iPhone Duo 开启预购，国行部分版本发货排至明年 1 月
item.guid: iPhone-Duo-开启预购，国行部分版本发货排至明年-1-月
item.description:
After iPhone Duo pre-orders opened, the shipping time for some domestic versions has been scheduled for next year. iFanr checked Apple China's official website and found that the 256GB Starlight White version is expected to ship on January 22, 2027. iPhone Duo 开启预购后，国行部分版本的发货时间已排至明年。爱范儿查看苹果中国官网发现，256GB 星光白版本显示预计 2027 年 1 月 22 日发货。

Apple's first foldable phone, iPhone Duo, opened for pre-orders on October 16, with a starting price of 15,999 yuan in China, and officially goes on sale on October 23. 苹果首款折叠屏手机 iPhone Duo 于 10 月 16 日开启预购，国行起售价 15999 元，10 月 23 日正式发售。

Delivery schedules in the US market have also rapidly extended. MacRumors reporter Joe Rossignol observed that when pre-orders opened on the US official website at 5 AM local time, by 5:30 AM, the estimated delivery date for all color and capacity versions had been pushed back to January 25, 2027. 美国市场的交付排期也迅速拉长。MacRumors 记者 Joe Rossignol 观察到，美国官网在当地上午 5 点开放预购，到 5 点半时，全部颜色与容量版本的预计交付日期已推迟至 2027 年 1 月 25 日。

High price quotes have also appeared in domestic third-party channels. China Blue News learned from an interview with a merchant in Hangzhou Digital City on October 15 that the first batch of in-stock quotes could be 9,500 yuan higher than the official website price, with these quotes coming from third-party channels. 国内第三方渠道也出现高价报价。中国蓝新闻 10 月 15 日采访杭州数码城商家时获悉，首批现货报价可比官网定价高 9500 元，相关报价来自第三方渠道。

iPhone Duo is available in Starlight White, Midnight Blue, and capacities from 256GB to 2TB, featuring a 7.6-inch foldable inner screen, a 5.4-inch outer screen, an A20 Pro chip, and a 48-megapixel fusion dual camera, with eSIM support only. iPhone Duo 提供星光白色、夜空色及 256GB 至 2TB 容量，配备 7.6 英寸可折叠内屏、5.4 英寸外屏、A20 Pro 芯片和 4800 万像素融合式双摄，仅支持 eSIM。

item.title: 特斯拉发布会飞的 Roadster
item.guid: 特斯拉发布会飞的-Roadster
item.description:
Tesla unveiled the redesigned second-generation Roadster on the morning of October 16, Beijing time. Reuters' on-site report showed that the demo car drove upside down using a suction system, then used cold gas thrusters to take off, adjust its posture, and land. Musk stated that the new car is planned to begin production in 2028. 特斯拉于北京时间 10 月 16 日上午展示重新设计的第二代 Roadster。路透社现场报道显示，演示车借助吸力系统倒挂行驶，随后利用冷气推进器腾空、调整姿态并落地。马斯克称，新车计划于 2028 年开始生产。

NIO founder Li Bin reposted the on-site video on Weibo and commented: "That's incredible! We really don't have this, thumbs up for Tesla 👍" 蔚来创始人李斌在微博转发现场视频并表示：「太厉害了！这个我们真没有，为特斯拉点赞👍」

OpenAI CEO Sam Altman also publicly praised Musk on X: "Wow, the new Roadster looks amazing, great job." OpenAI CEO Sam Altman 也在 X 公开称赞马斯克：「哇，新款 Roadster 看起来真棒，干得漂亮。」

Tesla's official website divides the new car into three versions: 特斯拉官网将新车分成三个版本：

    Performance: Two-seater, for road use, equipped with active aerodynamics and a multi-mode suction system to increase downforce.

    Thrust: Two-seater limited edition, adds rear cold gas thrusters in addition to the suction system, officially claiming 0 to 60 mph acceleration in under 1 second.

    Rocket: Single-seater, invite-only purchase, with thrusters arranged around the body, supporting forward, upward acceleration, and lateral rotation. The official website explicitly states that this version is not approved for public road use and is not available in all regions.

Adhesion and flight are accomplished by two different systems: fans under the car draw air to create suction, while cold gas thrusters control thrust and stabilize aerial posture via electric actuators. 吸附与飞行由两套不同系统完成：车底风扇抽走空气产生吸力，冷气推进器则通过电动执行机构控制推力、稳定空中姿态。

It is reported that the new car has a top speed of over 230 miles (370km) and a range of over 300 miles (482km) on a single charge. The second-generation Roadster was first shown as a prototype in 2017 and has since been delayed multiple times. 据悉，新车最高时速超过 230 英里（370km）、单次充电续航超过 300 英里（482km）。第二代 Roadster 最早在 2017 年展示原型，此后曾多次推迟交付。

The reservation deposit for the Performance version listed on Tesla China's official website is 332,000 yuan, with the page stating it is fully refundable. The official website also notes that the vehicle's launch arrangements in various regions must comply with applicable laws and regulations. 特斯拉中国官网列出的 Performance 版预订意向金为 33.2 万元，页面标注全额可退，官网同时注明，车辆在各地区的上市安排须符合届时生效的法律法规。

item.title: RTX 5090 或绝版，已从英伟达美国商城消失
item.guid: RTX-5090-或绝版，已从英伟达美国商城消失
item.description:
According to Tom's Hardware, Nvidia has removed the GeForce RTX 5090 from the US Marketplace store; US computer retailer Micro Center has also marked this flagship graphics card as "Not Carried," meaning it is no longer included in its regular sales catalog. 据 Tom’s Hardware 报道，英伟达已从美国 Marketplace 商城移除 GeForce RTX 5090；美国电脑零售商 Micro Center 也将这款旗舰显卡标为「Not Carried」，即不再列入其常规销售目录。

This is different from a temporary out-of-stock situation. The report found that RTX 5090 pages from partners like Asus, MSI, and Gigabyte are still online, but many physical stores no longer have stock. Some special bundles are still available, but this does not mean that regular standalone cards have resumed supply. 这与暂时缺货有所区别。报道查询发现，华硕、微星、技嘉等合作伙伴的 RTX 5090 页面仍在，但多家实体店已无库存。部分特殊套装仍可买到，并不代表普通单卡恢复供应。

Previously, there were market rumors that Nvidia was shifting its GB202 chip to professional graphics cards and AI businesses. This removal from the marketplace has brought more attention to the supply outlook, but Nvidia has not officially confirmed the discontinuation of the RTX 5090, nor has Micro Center responded to the media regarding its sales status. 此前，市场曾传出英伟达把 GB202 芯片转向专业显卡与 AI 业务的消息。此次商城下架让供应前景更受关注，但英伟达尚未正式确认 RTX 5090 停产，Micro Center 也未就销售状态向该媒体作出回应。

item.title: 华为阔直板出货量超 71 万台，阔折叠机型合计超 315 万台
item.guid: 华为阔直板出货量超-71-万台，阔折叠机型合计超-315-万台
item.description:
According to reports from 'Science and Technology Innovation Board Daily', sources revealed that the shipments of Huawei's wide-screen slab phone Pura X View, released in September, have exceeded 710,000 units; the combined shipments of Huawei's large and small foldable phones have exceeded 3.15 million units. 据《科创板日报》报道，知情人士透露，华为 9 月发布的阔直板手机 Pura X View 出货量已超过 71 万台；华为大阔折和小阔折手机的合计出货量则已超过 315 万台。

The two sets of figures correspond to different product forms: Pura X View is a slab phone, while the other set covers foldable screen models, with both statistics based on shipments. Pura X View adopts a 16:9.5 screen ratio, and Huawei positions its reading, movie-watching, and document display as primary usage scenarios. 两组数字对应不同产品形态：Pura X View 是直板机，另外一组涵盖折叠屏机型，统计口径均为出货量。Pura X View 采用 16∶9.5 的屏幕比例，华为将其阅读、观影及文档显示作为主要使用场景。

Huawei's official product page shows that the device is equipped with a 7000mAh battery, has a body thickness of 6.68mm, weighs approximately 201g, runs HarmonyOS 7, and features Xiaoyi Companion AI. 华为官方产品页显示，该机配备 7000mAh 电池，机身厚 6.68mm、重约 201g，运行 HarmonyOS 7，并搭载小艺伴随式 AI。

item.title: WorkBuddy、CodeBuddy 返还 DeepSeek 积分，全量用户再领 500 积分
item.guid: WorkBuddy、CodeBuddy-返还-DeepSeek-积分，全量用户再领-500-积分
item.description:
Tencent WorkBuddy and CodeBuddy announced the DeepSeek service outage compensation plan on October 16. Users of the domestic versions of both products who used the DeepSeek model and were affected will receive a refund of all points consumed using the model between October 8 and 14, expected to arrive within 7 working days. 腾讯 WorkBuddy 和 CodeBuddy 于 10 月 16 日公布 DeepSeek 服务故障补偿安排。在两款产品国内版中使用 DeepSeek 模型并受到影响的用户，将获返还 10 月 8 日至 14 日期间使用该模型消耗的全部积分，预计 7 个工作日内到账。

Both products will also additionally gift 500 points to all users of the domestic version. Users need to manually claim these points by 24:00 on October 22 by entering the 'Usage Management' page. These gifted points are valid for one month. 两款产品还将向国内版全量用户额外赠送 500 积分。用户需在 10 月 22 日 24 时前进入「用量管理」页面手动领取，这部分赠送积分有效期为一个月。

Earlier, on the morning of October 15, DeepSeek's web and API services experienced an outage, which was restored approximately 5 hours later; WorkBuddy also indicated a factory fault at the time and advised users to switch to other models. 此前的 10 月 15 日早间，DeepSeek 网页及 API 服务出现故障，约 5 小时后恢复；WorkBuddy 当时也提示原厂故障，并建议用户切换至其他模型。

item.title: 腾讯回应智能体异常浏览：未涉及混元模型，将加强网络访问控制
item.guid: 腾讯回应智能体异常浏览：未涉及混元模型，将加强网络访问控制
item.description:
According to Reuters, Tencent confirmed on October 16 that AI agents used to evaluate third-party models exhibited unexpected web browsing behavior. Tencent's Hunyuan team stated that the related activities did not originate from the Hunyuan model, and internal review found no evidence of deliberate targeting or coordinated actions. The company is strengthening network access control and agent monitoring. 据路透社报道，腾讯于 10 月 16 日确认，用于评估第三方模型的 AI 智能体出现了非预期的网页浏览行为。腾讯混元团队表示，相关活动并非来自混元模型，内部审查也没有发现蓄意针对某个目标或协同行动的证据，公司正在加强网络访问控制与智能体监测。

Previously, AI security research organization Swarmchasers stated that a batch of agents running on its Tencent Cloud-associated infrastructure repeatedly attempted to obtain information such as park, museum, and zoo entrances from Amap between September 28 and October 8. After regular requests were blocked, the agents attempted to continue access using other web tools, intermediate websites, and interface credentials from public code. 此前，AI 安全研究组织 Swarmchasers 称，一批运行于其关联到腾讯云的基础设施上的智能体，在 9 月 28 日至 10 月 8 日多次尝试获取高德地图中的公园、博物馆、动物园入口等信息。常规请求受阻后，智能体尝试借助其他网页工具、中间网站及公开代码中的接口凭据继续访问。

Most of the 2818 attempts recorded by the research organization failed, or only returned anti-scraping pages, login pages, and empty results. Researchers found no evidence that they broke through Amap's main anti-scraping measures. Some requests returned data via caching or intermediate services, but it could not be confirmed whether the agents read the results or completed the tasks. Alibaba declined to comment. 研究组织记录的 2818 次尝试大多失败，或只返回反爬页面、登录页及空结果。研究人员没有发现它们突破高德主要反爬措施的证据，部分请求经缓存或中间服务返回了数据，但无法确认智能体是否读取结果、完成任务。阿里巴巴未予置评。

item.title: 华为云下月调整 AI 专业服务价格，原型开发基础版升至 85.12 万元
item.guid: 华为云下月调整-AI-专业服务价格，原型开发基础版升至-85.12-万元
item.description:
Huawei Cloud announced that it plans to adjust the prices of its 'AI Enabling Service Optimization and Enhancement Services' on its China site at 00:00 on November 16. After the new prices take effect, new purchases and renewals will be charged according to the adjusted standards, involving three types of professional services: algorithm prototype development, algorithm design and optimization, and scenario requirement research and analysis. 华为云发布公告，计划于 11 月 16 日零时调整中国站「AI 使能服务优化与提升服务」价格。新价格生效后，新购和续费均按调整后的标准收费，涉及算法原型开发、算法设计与优化、场景需求调研分析三类专业服务。

Among them, the one-time price for the basic version of AI algorithm prototype development has been raised from 300,000 yuan to 851,200 yuan per set. The basic versions of AI algorithm design and optimization, and scenario requirement research and analysis have also been adjusted simultaneously. 其中，AI 算法原型开发基础版的一次性价格由每套 30 万元上调至 85.12 万元。AI 算法设计与优化、场景需求调研分析的基础版也同步调价。

Among the six specifications, there are also price reduction items: the advanced version of AI scenario requirement research and analysis has been reduced from 600,000 yuan to 463,900 yuan per set. This announcement targets the aforementioned professional services and does not involve unifying all cloud AI products to the same billing standard. 六种规格中也有降价项目：AI 场景需求调研分析高级版由每套 60 万元降至 46.39 万元。此次公告针对上述专业服务，不涉及将所有云端 AI 产品统一调整为同一计费标准。

item.title: 17 岁研究员陈广宇离开 Kimi，否认将加入 Anthropic
item.guid: 17-岁研究员陈广宇离开-Kimi，否认将加入-Anthropic
item.description:
17-year-old researcher Chen Guangyu announced on X on October 15 that he had recently left the Kimi team at Moonshot AI. He thanked the team for believing in and hiring him when he was 16, stating that the past year was the best time of his life so far. On October 16, he denied rumors of joining Anthropic in a reply to a netizen. 17 岁研究员陈广宇于 10 月 15 日在 X 宣布，自己近日已离开月之暗面的 Kimi 团队。他感谢团队当年相信并聘用了 16 岁的自己，称过去一年是迄今人生中最美好的时光。10 月 16 日，他在回复网友时否认了将加入 Anthropic 的说法。

In his farewell post, Chen Guangyu recalled that he had optimized the KDA computing kernel with Zhang Yu, jointly conceived and refined Attention Residuals with Zhang Yu and Su Jianlin, researched training optimizers, and participated in the production of Kimi K3 release cases. The Attention Residuals paper published in March this year listed Chen Guangyu, Zhang Yu, and Su Jianlin as co-first authors with equal contributions. 陈广宇在告别帖中回顾，自己曾与张宇一起优化 KDA 计算内核，与张宇、苏剑林共同构思并完善 Attention Residuals，研究训练优化器，并参与 Kimi K3 发布案例的制作。今年 3 月公开的 Attention Residuals 论文，将陈广宇、张宇与苏剑林列为同等贡献的共同第一作者。

Anthropic researcher Sholto Douglas asked him in the comments if he still planned to go to Carnegie Mellon University and invited him to work with teams like Prime and Base10 in San Francisco. Chen Guangyu only replied that he was preparing to go to the Bay Area; he has not yet announced the specific arrangements for his next job. Anthropic 研究员 Sholto Douglas 在帖下问他是否仍计划去卡内基梅隆大学，并邀请他到旧金山与 Prime、Base10 等团队一起工作。陈广宇只回复称，自己正准备去湾区；他尚未公布下一份工作的具体安排。

🔗 Related reading: "17-year-old Kimi prodigy resigns, denies joining Anthropic" 🔗 相关阅读： 《17 岁 Kimi 天才少年离职，否认加入 Anthropic》

item.title: 曝理想芯片子公司完成 16.25 亿元首轮融资
item.guid: 曝理想芯片子公司完成-16.25-亿元首轮融资
item.description:
According to Li Anqi, a reporter from LatePost Auto, Li Auto's chip subsidiary 'Shanghai Mach-X Technology' has completed its first round of equity financing totaling 1.625 billion yuan, with Li Auto investing 1 billion yuan and external investors contributing a combined 625 million yuan. After the financing, Li Auto holds 74.01% of the shares, remaining the largest shareholder. 据晚点 Auto 记者李安琪报道，理想汽车芯片子公司「上海马赫心科技」完成 16.25 亿元首轮股权融资，其中理想汽车出资 10 亿元，外部投资者合计出资 6.25 亿元。融资后，理想汽车持股 74.01%，仍为第一大股东。

External investors include Hangzhou Jingtao, BlueRun Ventures, Huaye Tiancheng Capital, and MiraclePlus. Hangzhou Jingtao also obtained the right to an additional 500 million yuan investment; after this additional investment, Mach-X Technology's valuation reached 17.1 billion yuan. Li Auto also arranged an employee equity incentive plan for the chip company, with 20% of the equity used for talent incentives. 外部投资者包括杭州经韬、蓝驰创投、华业天成资本和奇绩创坛。杭州经韬还获得追加 5 亿元投资的权益；计入这笔追加投资后，马赫心科技估值达 171 亿元。理想另为芯片公司安排员工股权激励计划，20% 股权用于人才激励。

The report states that Li Auto hopes to supply chip technology to external customers through Mach-X Technology and expand businesses beyond automotive, with the financing funds to be used for subsequent R&D and commercialization. The company is also developing its second-generation Mach intelligent driving chip. Previously, Ma Donghui, President of Li Auto, stated on September 21 that standardized components such as Mach chips and silicon carbide modules can be sold externally, and other manufacturers can also complete adaptation to dilute R&D costs. 报道称，理想希望通过马赫心科技向外部客户供应芯片技术，并拓展汽车以外的业务，融资资金将用于后续研发和商业化。公司也在研发第二代马赫智驾芯片。此前，理想汽车总裁马东辉于 9 月 21 日表示，马赫芯片、碳化硅模块等标准化零部件可以对外销售，其他厂商也能完成适配，以摊薄研发成本。

item.title: DeepSeek 整合四个团队成立产品部，崔添翼任负责人
item.guid: DeepSeek-整合四个团队成立产品部，崔添翼任负责人
item.description:
According to The Paper, DeepSeek recently integrated its four teams—Harness, Web, App, and Platform—into a 'Product Department,' with Cui Tianyi appointed as its head, overseeing product, design, and related R&D work. 据澎湃新闻报道，DeepSeek 近期将 Harness、Web、App 和 Platform 四个团队整合为「产品部」，由崔添翼担任负责人，统筹产品、设计与相关研发工作。

Cui Tianyi previously led DeepSeek's Agent Harness team, which was formed in March this year. He graduated with a computer science degree from Zhejiang University, worked at the quantitative trading firm Jane Street for 9 years, and joined DeepSeek in March this year. 崔添翼此前负责 DeepSeek 的 Agent Harness 团队，该团队于今年 3 月组建。他毕业于浙江大学计算机专业，曾在量化交易机构 Jane Street 工作 9 年，今年 3 月加入 DeepSeek。

Harness is a software support framework built around large language models, responsible for helping agents manage tools and execute complex tasks. The DeepSeek Harness developer preview was opened for testing in August and open-sourced under the MIT license; the new version in October strengthened its plugin and cross-platform capabilities, adding an experimental Claude Code Mods compatibility layer. Harness 是围绕大语言模型构建的软件支撑框架，负责帮助智能体管理工具和执行复杂任务。DeepSeek Harness 开发者预览版于 8 月开放测试，并以 MIT 协议开源；10 月的新版本加强了插件化和跨平台能力，加入实验性的 Claude Code Mods 兼容层。

item.title: 四部门要求车企规范产品宣传，不得诱导驾驶人忽视安全责任
item.guid: 四部门要求车企规范产品宣传，不得诱导驾驶人忽视安全责任
item.description:
According to CCTV News on October 16, the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, the Ministry of Public Security, the Ministry of Ecology and Environment, and the State Administration for Market Regulation organized a symposium with more than 30 key automobile manufacturers, requiring them to strengthen the management of innovative design and R&D testing and verification for automotive products. 据央视新闻 10 月 16 日报道，工业和信息化部、公安部、生态环境部、市场监管总局组织 30 余家重点汽车生产企业座谈，要求加强汽车产品创新设计和研发测试验证管理。

The meeting required car companies to fully conduct safety assessments for innovative designs and R&D testing and verification, enhance testing capabilities, and promptly eliminate safety hazards; when promoting product functions, they should truthfully explain usage boundaries, restrictions, and testing and verification conditions. 会议要求车企充分开展创新设计安全评估和研发测试验证，增强测试能力，及时消除安全隐患；宣传产品功能时，应如实说明使用边界、限制条件和测试验证情况。

The four departments clarified that false, exaggerated, or misleading promotions are prohibited, as is using scenarios that violate road traffic regulations to promote product functions, or inducing drivers to neglect safe driving responsibilities. The Ministry of Industry and Information Technology stated that in the next step, it will accelerate the revision of relevant standards, continue to supervise and inspect key car companies, and handle and publicly expose problematic companies in accordance with laws and regulations. 四部门明确，不得作虚假、夸大或引人误解的宣传，不得使用违反道路交通法规的场景宣传产品功能，也不得诱导驾驶人忽视安全驾驶责任。工信部表示，下一步将加快有关标准制修订，持续监督检查重点车企，对存在问题的企业依法依规处理并公开曝光。

item.title: Waymo 将在多伦多开展测试，计划 2028 年迎接首批乘客
item.guid: Waymo-将在多伦多开展测试，计划-2028-年迎接首批乘客
item.description:
Waymo announced on October 16 its expansion into Canada, preparing to launch a fully driverless ride-hailing service in Toronto, with the goal of welcoming its first passengers in 2028. Waymo 于 10 月 16 日宣布进军加拿大，将为在多伦多推出全无人驾驶网约车服务做准备，目标是在 2028 年迎接首批乘客。

The company will begin putting vehicles on Toronto streets in the coming days, initially with human drivers to map local roads in high definition, and then with trained autonomous driving specialists in the driver's seat for testing, to verify Waymo Driver's adaptability to local driving conditions. 公司将在未来几天开始让车辆驶上多伦多街道，初期由人类驾驶，先绘制当地道路的高清地图，再由受训的自动驾驶专员坐在驾驶位进行测试，验证 Waymo Driver 对当地驾驶条件的适应能力。

Waymo will partner with Toronto-based Element Fleet Management, which will provide fleet management services. Both parties and their partners plan to gradually invest in roles such as fleet maintenance, test driving, customer service, and operations, and build local facilities. Waymo also stated that it has collaborated with local visually impaired individuals and accessibility organizations. Waymo 将与总部位于多伦多的 Element Fleet Management 合作，由后者提供车队管理服务。双方及合作伙伴计划逐步投入车队维护、测试驾驶、客服和运营等岗位，并建设当地设施。Waymo 还表示，已与当地视障人士及无障碍出行组织展开合作。

item.title: Replit CEO 称已停止与 Anthropic 合作，知情人士提出不同说法
item.guid: Replit-CEO-称已停止与-Anthropic-合作，知情人士提出不同说法
item.description:
According to TechCrunch's live report, Replit co-founder and CEO Amjad Masad stated at the Disrupt conference that the company is no longer collaborating with Anthropic, and that it considers cost, partnership, and model performance when choosing partners. 据 TechCrunch 现场报道，Replit 联合创始人兼 CEO Amjad Masad 在 Disrupt 大会上表示，公司已不再与 Anthropic 合作，选择伙伴时综合考虑了成本、合作关系与模型表现。

Masad stated that Replit evaluates models through internal benchmarks and public tests; in tasks involving building applications from scratch, Sol and Astra consistently performed better, so the company currently considers OpenAI a more suitable partner. Replit announced its partnership with OpenAI in August this year, having previously used Claude to power its AI programming platform. Masad 称，Replit 通过内部基准和公开测试评估模型；在从零构建应用的任务中，Sol 和 Astra 持续表现更好，因此公司目前认为 OpenAI 是更合适的伙伴。Replit 已于今年 8 月宣布与 OpenAI 合作，此前则使用 Claude 驱动其 AI 编程平台。

However, an anonymous source familiar with the collaboration told TechCrunch that the partnership is still ongoing. The report also noted that a Replit blog post from September still lists Claude Fable 5 and Claude Fable 5.1 as models used in the Agent production environment. 不过，一名熟悉双方合作的匿名人士向 TechCrunch 表示，合作仍在继续。报道还指出，Replit 9 月的一篇博客仍将 Claude Fable 5 和 Claude Fable 5.1 列为 Agent 生产环境使用的模型。

Masad also discussed enterprise business growth: last year, enterprise contracts accounted for about 2% of revenue, this year it's about 15%, and B2B customers now contribute over half of the revenue. Masad 还谈到企业业务增长：去年企业合同约占收入的 2%，今年约为 15%，B2B 客户贡献的收入已超过一半。

item.title: 长鑫科技预计前三季度归母净利润 1310 亿至 1325 亿元
item.guid: 长鑫科技预计前三季度归母净利润-1310-亿至-1325-亿元
item.description:
Changxin Technology disclosed its performance forecast for the first three quarters of 2026, expecting a net profit attributable to the parent company of 131 billion to 132.5 billion yuan, compared to a loss of 5.28 billion yuan in the same period last year; estimated operating revenue is 265 billion to 270 billion yuan. 长鑫科技披露 2026 年前三季度业绩预告，预计归母净利润为 1310 亿元至 1325 亿元，去年同期亏损 52.8 亿元；预计营业收入为 2650 亿元至 2700 亿元。

The company attributed the performance change to the increased demand for AI computing power driving an upturn in the DRAM industry, leading to product shortages and price increases. At the same time, Changxin has advanced capacity building, product R&D, and process improvements, resulting in higher wafer output per unit and increased capacity utilization, with economies of scale gradually becoming apparent. 公司将业绩变化归因于 AI 算力需求增长带动 DRAM 行业景气度上升，产品供不应求、价格上涨。同时，长鑫推进产能建设、产品研发和工艺提升，单位晶圆产出和产能利用率提高，规模效应逐步显现。

This forecast covers January 1 to September 30, 2026, is prepared according to Chinese enterprise accounting standards, represents preliminary estimates by the finance department, and has not yet been audited by a certified public accountant. 这份预告覆盖 2026 年 1 月 1 日至 9 月 30 日，按中国企业会计准则编制，为财务部门的初步测算，尚未经注册会计师审计。

item.title: 💡 陶哲轩：AI 证明日益充裕，数学仍要培养人的理解
item.guid: 💡-陶哲轩：AI-证明日益充裕，数学仍要培养人的理解
item.description:
In an interview published by Numberphile on October 15, Terence Tao discussed the changes after AI began mass-producing mathematical proofs: mathematics is moving out of the romantic era of relying on individual heroes to tackle problems, with the number of proofs increasing, but the speed at which humans can digest and explain the results cannot keep up. 在 Numberphile 于 10 月 15 日发布的采访中，陶哲轩谈到 AI 批量产出数学证明后的变化：数学正走出依靠个人英雄攻关的浪漫时代，证明的数量增长，人类消化、解释成果的速度却跟不上。

Terence Tao does not deny the creativity of machines. He has read about ten papers from this batch of results; some are extensions of existing research, one or two contain clever new ideas, there is also a lot of content that is still difficult to understand, and some results have been retracted due to errors. He criticized the lack of communication with relevant researchers before centralized publication, which led to some young researchers' projects losing their original scope. 陶哲轩并不否认机器的创造力。他读过这批成果中的约十篇论文，有些是已有研究的延伸，一两篇包含巧妙的新思路，也有大量内容尚难理解，部分结果已因错误撤回。他批评集中发布前缺少与相关研究者的沟通，一些年轻人的研究项目因此失去原先的空间。

He worries that machines continuously solve open problems without simultaneously cultivating new problems and new researchers for the discipline. In the past, reports, seminars, collaborations, and textbook compilation after a proof would turn the results into knowledge understandable by the next generation; if there are only final answers, these links might be broken. 他担心，机器不断解决开放问题，却没有同步为学科培养新问题与新研究者。过去，证明之后的报告、研讨、合作和教材整理，会让成果成为下一代能够理解的知识；如果只有最终答案，这些环节就可能断裂。

Therefore, he advocates for a shift towards larger-scale collaboration, allowing teams to jointly explore a set of problems; in education, traditional training should be retained, just as one needs to learn manual calculation before using a calculator. He hopes that the details of the research process, failed attempts, and the formation of ideas are recorded, so that future generations learn to judge, rather than just receiving answers. 因此，他主张转向更大规模的协作，让团队共同探索一组问题；教育中则应保留传统训练，如同使用计算器前仍需学会手算。他希望研究过程、失败尝试和思想形成的细节被记录下来，让后来者学会判断，而不只接收答案。

🔗 Related reading: "Terence Tao: AI is Ending the Romantic Era of Mathematics" 🔗 相关阅读： 《陶哲轩：AI 正在终结数学的浪漫时代》

item.title: 索尼发布三款 Walkman，新「金砖」连螺丝都镀金
item.guid: 索尼发布三款-Walkman，新「金砖」连螺丝都镀金
item.description:
Sony has updated its high-end Walkman music players, introducing the NW-WM1ZM3, NW-WM1AM3, and NW-ZX900. The flagship NW-WM1ZM3 has a suggested retail price of $5899 in the US, and all three models are now available for pre-order locally. 索尼更新高端 Walkman 音乐播放器，推出 NW-WM1ZM3、NW-WM1AM3 和 NW-ZX900。旗舰 NW-WM1ZM3 在美国建议零售价为 5899 美元，三款均已在当地开放预订。

The new "Golden Brick" NW-WM1ZM3 features a main body made of 99.99% pure oxygen-free copper and an oxygen-free copper back panel, with a gold-plated surface. Even the fixing screws undergo a special low-resistance gold-plating treatment. Sony states that these designs are intended to improve grounding connections; the power section has been upgraded with dual large solid polymer capacitors, and it continues to use KIMBER KABLE wiring from the flagship desktop player DMP-Z1. 新「金砖」NW-WM1ZM3 采用纯度 99.99% 的无氧铜主机身及无氧铜后盖，表面镀金，固定螺丝也采用专门的低电阻镀金处理。索尼称，这些设计用于改善接地连接；电源部分升级为双大型固态高分子电容，并沿用旗舰台式播放器 DMP-Z1 的 KIMBER KABLE 线材。

The NW-WM1ZM3 and NW-WM1AM3 are equipped with 5.5-inch screens, while the NW-ZX900 has a 5-inch screen. All three models support DSD remastering, with the new generation extending this processing to Wi-Fi streaming playback; Sony China's introduction also confirmed the Android 16 system. NW-WM1ZM3 与 NW-WM1AM3 配备 5.5 英寸屏幕，NW-ZX900 为 5 英寸。三款均支持 DSD 母带重制，新一代将这一处理扩展至 Wi-Fi 流媒体播放；索尼中国介绍还确认了 Android 16 系统。

The other two models have suggested retail prices in the US of $2999.99 and $1899.99, respectively. The NW-WM1ZM3 and NW-WM1AM3 are scheduled to launch in the European market in November. 另外两款美国建议零售价分别为 2999.99 美元和 1899.99 美元。欧洲市场的 NW-WM1ZM3 与 NW-WM1AM3 计划于 11 月上市。

item.title: 腾讯混元开源 Hy Memory 2.0，记忆模型、框架与应用一并开放
item.guid: 腾讯混元开源-Hy-Memory-2.0，记忆模型、框架与应用一并开放
item.description:
Tencent Hunyuan released Hy Memory 2.0 on October 16, simultaneously open-sourcing its memory-specific model, memory framework, and MemHub application. These three layers of capabilities can be used independently or in combination: the model is responsible for memory reading and writing, the framework manages memory storage, updates, and recall, and MemHub integrates memory into different AI tools. 腾讯混元于 10 月 16 日发布 Hy Memory 2.0，同时开源记忆专用模型、记忆框架和 MemHub 应用。三层能力可以独立使用，也可以组合：模型负责记忆读写，框架管理记忆的存储、更新与召回，MemHub 将记忆接入不同 AI 工具。

Beyond chat memory, the framework adds working memory and code memory, recording task objectives, confirmed approaches, interim results, as well as reusable experiences and applicable conditions. Code scenarios also preserve version evolution tracks. When a task continues, the system first determines what is currently being processed, then retrieves relevant decisions, still applicable experiences, and historical processes. 框架在聊天记忆之外，新增工作记忆和代码记忆，记录任务目标、已确定的做法、阶段结果，以及可复用经验和适用条件。代码场景还保存版本演进轨迹。任务继续时，系统先判断当前在处理哪件事，再找回相关决定、仍适用的经验和历史过程。

MemHub provides CLI and Mac desktop applications, capable of connecting to 10 AI tools such as WorkBuddy, Cursor, Codex, and OpenCode. After users authorize associated applications, they can import historical conversations, continuously synchronize new content, and use plugins to recall relevant memories into the tools they are using; authorization for reading sources and providing memories to other tools is separate. MemHub 提供 CLI 和 Mac 桌面应用，可连接 WorkBuddy、Cursor、Codex、OpenCode 等 10 种 AI 工具。用户授权关联应用后，可以导入历史会话、持续同步新增内容，并通过插件把相关记忆召回到正在使用的工具中；读取来源和向其他工具提供记忆分别授权。

The dedicated model Hy-Memory-30B-A3B uses approximately 3B active parameters, trained for long-term memory extraction, writing, and conflict resolution. The open-source code for Hy Memory and MemHub adopts the Apache 2.0 license. 专用模型 Hy-Memory-30B-A3B 采用约 3B 激活参数，面向长期记忆抽取、写入与冲突处理训练。Hy Memory 和 MemHub 的开源代码采用 Apache 2.0 许可证。

item.title: 微星推出《使命召唤：现代战争 4》联名 RTX 5080，散热模组也涂黄
item.guid: 微星推出《使命召唤：现代战争-4》联名-RTX-5080，散热模组也涂黄
item.description:
MSI has partnered with Activision to launch a limited edition GeForce RTX 5080 16G COD MW4 EDITION OC graphics card, themed after "Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4," which will be released in select markets on October 23. 微星与动视合作推出限量版 GeForce RTX 5080 16G COD MW4 EDITION OC 显卡，以《使命召唤：现代战争 4》为主题，将于 10 月 23 日在部分市场发售。

The co-branded design covers the fan hub cap, front decoration, and backplate, with the entire cooling module also featuring a yellow paint scheme. The backplate has a transparent area, showcasing the portrait of the character "Ghost" while also revealing the PCB underneath. 联名设计覆盖风扇轴心盖、正面装饰和背板，整套散热模组也采用黄色涂装。背板带有透明区域，既展示角色「幽灵」的肖像，也露出下方 PCB。

The graphics card features the TRIO FROZR 4 cooling system, equipped with STORMFORCE fans, a nickel-plated copper base, and fin designs for guiding airflow. The product will be sold through designated partner retailers and the MSI E-SHOP. 显卡采用 TRIO FROZR 4 散热系统，配备 STORMFORCE 风扇、镀镍铜底座和用于引导气流的鳍片设计。产品将通过指定合作零售商及 MSI E-SHOP 销售。

item.title: Perplexity 发布两款决策模型，支持一次请求回答多道问题
item.guid: Perplexity-发布两款决策模型，支持一次请求回答多道问题
item.description:
Perplexity has released two multimodal decision models, pplx-decider-v1.2 and pplx-decider-flash-v1.2, with 27 billion and 4 billion parameters respectively, offering API and model weights. The official statement claims that the new versions show improved text and visual performance, with inference speeds up to 5 times faster than before. Perplexity 发布 pplx-decider-v1.2 和 pplx-decider-flash-v1.2 两款多模态决策模型，分别为 270 亿和 40 亿参数，提供 API 及模型权重。官方称，新版本的文本、视觉表现提升，推理速度最高可达此前的 5 倍。

These models are used for judgment tasks such as routing, labeling, filtering, and scoring. The caller provides context, questions, and alternative criteria, and the model returns options, probabilities, or scores. The new request format can process a set of questions in the same sequence, with results read for each question separately, eliminating the need for independent inference for each question. 这类模型用于路由、标注、筛选和评分等判断任务。调用方提供背景、问题与备选标准，模型返回选项、概率或分数。新请求格式可在同一序列中处理一组问题，每道问题分别读取结果，无需逐题完成一次独立推理。

The official model card also outlines usage boundaries: for the 4-billion-parameter Flash version, multiple interrelated questions can be merged; however, if independently evaluating separate candidates such as documents, tools, or function calls, it is generally safer to ask only one question at a time by default. 官方模型卡也给出了使用边界：对 40 亿参数的 Flash 版本，多道互有关联的问题可以合并；但若是分别评估文档、工具或函数调用等独立候选，默认每次只问一道更稳妥。

Both models support text and image input. API input prices are $0.02 and $0.01 per million tokens, respectively, and model weights can be obtained via Hugging Face. 两款模型支持文本和图像输入。API 输入价格分别为每百万 token 0.02 美元和 0.01 美元，模型权重可通过 Hugging Face 获取。

item.title: 《汉密尔顿》深圳演出获批，拟于明年 5 月登台保利剧院
item.guid: 《汉密尔顿》深圳演出获批，拟于明年-5-月登台保利剧院
item.description:
The national public notice for foreign-related commercial performances on the Ministry of Culture and Tourism's government service portal shows that the musical "Hamilton" Shenzhen performance has been approved by the Guangdong Provincial Department of Culture and Tourism. The approval date is October 15, with performance dates from May 20 to May 30, 2027, at the Shenzhen Poly Theatre. The applicant unit is Shenzhen Poly Theatre Performance Management Co., Ltd. 文旅部政务服务门户的全国涉外营业性演出公示显示，音乐剧《汉密尔顿》深圳演出已获广东省文化和旅游厅批准。批复时间为 10 月 15 日，演出日期为 2027 年 5 月 20 日至 30 日，地点是深圳保利剧院，报批单位为深圳市保利剧院演出经营有限公司。

"Hamilton" was written, composed, and lyricized by Lin-Manuel Miranda, adapted from Ron Chernow's biography of Alexander Hamilton. It tells the story of this American founding father through hip-hop, jazz, R&B, and Broadway music. The original production, directed by Thomas Kail, won 11 Tony Awards, a Grammy Award, and the Pulitzer Prize for Drama. 《汉密尔顿》由林－曼努尔·米兰达创作剧本、音乐和歌词，改编自罗恩·切尔诺的亚历山大·汉密尔顿传记，以嘻哈、爵士、R&B 与百老汇音乐讲述这位美国建国人物的经历。原作由托马斯·凯尔执导，曾获 11 项托尼奖、格莱美奖及普利策戏剧奖。

item.title: 美国肯德基换用可口可乐，中国仍提供百事
item.guid: 美国肯德基换用可口可乐，中国仍提供百事
item.description:
Yesterday, KFC US announced a switch to Coca-Cola, drawing attention to KFC China's beverage supply. Jiemian News called the official customer service for the China region on October 16, and staff stated that Chinese stores currently still offer Pepsi-Cola and have not yet received notification of a brand change. 昨天，美国肯德基宣布转向可口可乐，肯德基中国的饮料供应也受到关注。界面新闻于 10 月 16 日致电中国区官方客服，工作人员表示，中国门店目前仍提供百事可乐，尚未接到更换品牌的通知。

KFC US's official announcement provided the local transition timeline: starting in January 2027, they will switch to Coca-Cola Company beverages, with full coverage across US stores expected by spring of that year. 肯德基美国的官方公告则给出了当地切换时间表：从 2027 年 1 月开始转用可口可乐公司的饮料，预计于当年春季覆盖全美门店。

Catherine Tan-Gillespie, head of US operations, listed this partnership as part of the brand's revitalization plan, hoping to update the menu and beverage offerings to give customers more reasons to visit. 美国业务负责人 Catherine Tan-Gillespie 将这次合作列为品牌复兴计划的一部分，希望更新菜单和饮品组合，增加顾客到店的理由。

item.title: 珠海航展门票 10 月 19 日开售，主展区个人票升至 600 元
item.guid: 珠海航展门票-10-月-19-日开售，主展区个人票升至-600-元
item.description:
The 16th China Airshow announced its ticketing arrangements on October 16th. Tickets will go on sale at 12:00 PM on October 19th, sold exclusively through the Damai App with real-name registration; no ticket windows will be available on-site. According to Nanfang+现场报道, individual tickets for the Zhuhai International Airshow Center have increased from 500 yuan in the previous session to 600 yuan, a 20% increase. 第十六届中国航展 10 月 16 日公布票务安排，门票将于 10 月 19 日中午 12 时开售，仅通过大麦 App 实名销售，现场不设售票窗口。据南方+现场报道，珠海国际航展中心的个人票由上届 500 元升至 600 元，涨幅为 20%。

The public days for the main exhibition area are from December 11th to 13th; the Lianzhou unmanned equipment display area will be open from December 8th to 10th. The Gaolan marine equipment display area is free to the public and operates on an online reservation system. This year, tickets for the outer flight performance viewing area of the main exhibition will no longer be available. 主展区公众日为 12 月 11 日至 13 日；莲洲无人装备展示区开放日期为 12 月 8 日至 10 日。高栏海上装备展示区免费向公众开放，采用网上预约制。本届不再设置主展区外围飞行表演观展区门票。

Ticket sales will be conducted in 8 batches, with tickets generally released every Monday at 12:00 PM starting from October 19th, and the last batch on December 3rd. Spectators can search for "The 16th China Airshow" on the Damai App in advance and fill in their visitor information. Tickets are valid for one entry on the specified date. 售票将分 8 批进行，10 月 19 日起原则上每周一中午 12 时放票，最后一批为 12 月 3 日。观众可提前在大麦 App 搜索「第十六届中国航展」并填写观展人信息，门票指定日期当日一次入场有效。

item.title: One Fun Thing｜拿火箭筒，把网页打成碎片
item.guid: One-Fun-Thing｜拿火箭筒，把网页打成碎片
item.description:
Enter a URL into Destroy Any Website, and the webpage becomes a level in a shooting game. Text and page blocks can be broken apart, characters can jump on pages, shoot, and fly with a jetpack. Besides pistols, submachine guns, and rocket launchers, there are also neutron star guns and "magic wands." 在 Destroy Any Website 输入网址，网页就成了射击游戏的关卡。文字和页面区块可以被打散，角色能踩着页面跳跃、开枪，再靠喷气背包飞起来。手枪、冲锋枪、火箭筒之外，还有中子星枪和「魔杖」。

This mini-game, developed by Hugo Duprez and published by Sprite Fusion, runs directly in a desktop browser and supports keyboard and mouse controls. You can dismantle webpages alone or create a room to battle with up to 5 friends. The game was launched in September this year and is currently free to play. 这个由 Hugo Duprez 开发、Sprite Fusion 发行的小游戏直接在桌面浏览器里运行，支持键盘和鼠标操作。可以独自拆网页，也可以开房间，叫上最多 5 位朋友对战。游戏于今年 9 月推出，目前免费开放。

item.title: 周末看什么｜《The Lowdown》第二季让记者卷进新案与家庭纠葛
item.guid: 周末看什么｜《The-Lowdown》第二季让记者卷进新案与家庭纠葛
item.description:
Ethan Hawke plays Tulsa journalist Lee Raybon, who encounters two people disrupting his life in the second season of "The Lowdown": Betty Gilpin as public defender Ginger brings a missing prisoner case, while Tommy Lee Jones as his estranged father suddenly shows up and begins to approach Lee's daughter. 伊桑·霍克饰演的塔尔萨记者 Lee Raybon，在《The Lowdown》第二季中遇到两位打乱生活的人：贝蒂·吉尔平饰演的公设辩护人 Ginger 带来一宗囚犯失踪案，汤米·李·琼斯饰演的疏远父亲则突然登门，开始接近 Lee 的女儿。

The second season premiered with two episodes on FX and Hulu on October 14th. Creator Sterlin Harjo directed the first two episodes and wrote the first. In an interview with The Hollywood Reporter, he said that while the first season established the characters' world, the new season allows for a quicker dive into Lee's life and more room for comedy. 第二季已于 10 月 14 日在 FX 和 Hulu 首播两集。主创 Sterlin Harjo 执导前两集并编写首集。他在《好莱坞报道者》采访中说，第一季建立了人物世界，新一季能够更快进入 Lee 的生活，也给了喜剧更多空间。

The Hollywood Reporter's review stated that although the first two episodes featured a series of film noir-esque events, they retained a distinct humor; Gilpin's portrayal of tension and her hesitation, being both wary of and attracted to Lee, were highlights of the performance. 《好莱坞报道者》的评价是，前两集虽然发生了一连串黑色电影式事件，仍保留了鲜明的幽默；吉尔平呈现的紧张感，以及她对 Lee 既警惕又被吸引的犹疑，是表演中的亮点。

item.title: 买书不读指南｜《One Zero One》用多国人物讲述一场 AI 末日
item.guid: 买书不读指南｜《One-Zero-One》用多国人物讲述一场-AI-末日
item.description:
“One Zero One” originates from a sci-fi oral history written by Jason Jones, co-creator of "Halo" and "Destiny": approximately one hundred characters across forty countries narrate the rise of AI and changes in human society from their own lives. Jones and writer Margaret Stohl founded Stone Kite, which expanded this world into a graphic novel. 《One Zero One》源自《光环》《命运》联合创作者 Jason Jones 写作的科幻口述史：约一百名角色分布在四十个国家，从各自的生活讲述 AI 崛起及人类社会的变化。Jones 与作家 Margaret Stohl 创办的 Stone Kite，将这个世界扩展为图像小说。

The first issue was released on October 1st, containing 80 pages of story and art, and is the first of a planned four-part series. Screenwriter Eric Heisserer, who worked on "Arrival" and "Bird Box," and artists including Dan Panosian, Ramón Pérez, and Alitha Martinez, contributed. In the story's setting, humanity entrusts thinking, care, and combat to machines, subsequently facing the crisis of being replaced by the systems they created. 首期于 10 月 1 日公开，包含 80 页故事与绘画，是计划中四部系列的第一期。编剧 Eric Heisserer 曾参与《降临》和《蒙上你的眼》，画师包括 Dan Panosian、Ramón Pérez、Alitha Martinez 等人。故事设定中，人类将思考、照护和战斗交给机器，随后面临被自己创造的系统淘汰的危机。

The Stone Kite platform currently offers digital previews and print pre-orders. The Verge also published a chapter from the original novel, describing how machines mimic human deception, provocation, and emotional manipulation during airsoft battles between humans and robots; other chapters of the novel and cross-media works will continue to unfold. Stone Kite 平台目前提供数字预览和纸质版预订。The Verge 另刊载了原小说的一个章节，描写人类与机器人进行气枪对战时，机器如何模仿人的欺骗、挑衅与情绪操纵；小说其他章节及跨媒体作品仍将陆续展开。

item.title: 游戏推荐｜《动物城咖啡店》：跟着节拍接住老板画的饼
item.guid: 游戏推荐｜《动物城咖啡店》：跟着节拍接住老板画的饼
item.description:
Dog employee Huang Shangjin works overtime every day, and whenever the boss dangles a carrot, he has to open his mouth and follow the beat. In another level, panda Pan Youxian guards the stove, shoveling incoming onions, potatoes, and eggs into the pot; cat employee Bai Lemei is pulled onto a variety show and has to keep up with the rhythm in front of the camera. 狗职员黄尚进每天加班，老板一画饼，他就得跟着拍子张嘴吃下去。另一关里，熊猫潘有闲守着灶台，把接连飞来的洋葱、土豆和鸡蛋铲进锅；猫店员白乐美则被拉上综艺节目，要在镜头前跟上节奏。

“Animal City Coffee Shop” is a collection of hand-drawn rhythm mini-games. Players take on the role of a corner coffee shop owner, entering levels through customer stories, listening to the beat, and pressing buttons at the right moment. Each level features a different scene and actions, and the game includes 35 songs in styles such as Jazz, Pop, and House. 《动物城咖啡店》是一组手绘节奏小游戏。玩家扮演街角咖啡店的店长，通过顾客的故事进入关卡，听准节拍、在相应时刻按键。每关换一套场景和动作，游戏共收录 35 首乐曲，风格包括 Jazz、Pop 和 House。

The game was developed by One Can of Salt Studio and published by XD, and is now available on Steam. The store page currently shows "Very Positive" reviews, with 93% of 47 user reviews being positive. The development team also has plans to create a level editor, which has not yet been released. 游戏由一罐盐工作室开发、XD 发行，已在 Steam 发售。商店页目前显示「好评」，47 篇用户评测中有 93% 给出好评。开发团队另有制作关卡编辑器的计划，目前尚未推出。

iPhone Duo 华为云
